metricDefinitions.consumableRate: Net Consumable Value / Overall POS NSI counted up to each outlet's last consumable posting date
metricDefinitions.consumableWindow: Consumable issues post in batches, so each outlet's sales base stops on the day of its last consumable posting. An outlet that posted nothing in the period has no consumable rate rather than 0%.
metricDefinitions.wastageSalesRate: Net Wastage Value / Overall POS NSI
metricDefinitions.wastagePnpRate: Net Wastage Value / FRESH PRODUCE POS NSI
metricDefinitions.sapNetValue: Movement issues less reversals, using Posting Date
metricDefinitions.aggregateRate: Sum of value divided by sum of denominator (weighted performance)
metricDefinitions.outletAverage: Simple average of valid outlet-level percentages within the selected group
